_readme: Every user-facing string in English. JSON rather than TS on purpose: scripts/generate-brand-assets.mjs runs in plain Node and reads this same file, so the Open Graph card and the page cannot drift apart. Keys must match ja.json — src/locales/index.ts types both as one shape. Asset paths and layout live in src/data/mocks/home.ts.
_stats_readme: hero.stats labels must stay unique: <HeroStats> keys its cards by label. The values are placeholders awaiting real figures — fill them in or drop the section rather than inventing numbers.

_nav_readme: `path` is the page's own segment, with no locale in it. The URL is assembled by localeHref(locale, path) (src/locales/index.ts). Do not write hrefs here — that is how a locale prefix ends up doubled or missing.

_contact_readme: Deliberately not in `nav`. Reached from the header's CTA slot (where Figma put "Send Request") and from the phone's menu panel. A fifth nav item widens the centre pill until it collides with the logo at 1024px — see the note in src/views/home/site-header.tsx. Keep `cta.label` short enough for the 9.1875rem pill. `errors.*` duplicate the backend's validation, which is not redundancy: anything answerable without a round trip is answered in the browser (keep the limits in step with gc_run_functions/contact_form/main.py).
